transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um... well, it's work related. I manage construction sites, and... lately, if I have to get anywhere near a scaffold, or a roof edge, or an upper platform... my head just tells me I'm about to go over. 

Even when I can clearly see the rails are in place and I know the setup is safe, I just... yeah. That's what brings me in.
Do you ever feel this same kind of fear or panic in other situations, or does it only happen when you're near heights at work?
No... not really. Just... just the heights. I don't really notice it anywhere else.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports fear exclusively related to heights, which is consistent with acrophobia (F40.290). Other candidates (F41.9, F40.00, F43.10) are ruled out due to the specific nature of the fear and absence of symptoms related to other anxiety or trauma-related disorders.
